# Example Program 2 — [Phase/Athlete TBD: appears to be a 4-week strength-testing/peaking block, Advanced]

*Raw program as written by the coach. Preserved as-written to serve as a few-shot example for AI program generation — do not edit for "correctness," only to fix transcription errors.*

**Notation key (inferred from the sheet):**
- Circuit numbering (`1a`, `1b`, `2a`, `2b`...) = exercises grouped/paired within a block, performed back-to-back before resting
- `Sets x Reps` — e.g., `5x3` = 5 sets of 3; `/s` = per side; `xmax` = max reps
- Load columns (Week 1–4) show planned progressive overload, culminating in Week 3/4 rep-max attempts on several lifts
- Cue column includes both exact spoken phrasing ("actually do them if you do it on your own") and instructional pacing notes (e.g., 5RM attempt protocol)
